title.narrative: CELESC-D Energy Infrastructure Investment Program
Programa de Inversiones en Infraestructura Energtica Celesc-D

description.narrative: El objetivo general del programa es contribuir a incrementar la productividad en el EdSC, mediante el suministro de energa elctrica con calidad. Los objetivos especficos son: (i) atender la demanda creciente de energa elctrica, mediante la ampliacin y modernizacin de la red de distribucin de Celesc-D; (ii) mejorar la confiabilidad del sistema elctrico; (iii) mejorar la eficiencia de la operacin de Celesc-D; y (iv) incentivar una mayor participacin de gnero en Celesc-D.

The program's overall objective is to help boost productivity in the State of Santa Catarina by facilitating a quality supply of electric power. Its specific objectives are to: (i) satisfy the growing demand for electric power by expanding and modernizing CELESC-D's distribution network; (ii) improve the reliability of the power grid; (iii) enhance CELESEC-D's operational efficiency; and (iv) foster greater gender equality at CELESC-D.
